verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe replying to review comments to ask for clarification (cubic-docs-5), issuing commands via PR comments (e.g. '@cubic-dev-ai review this PR' in cubic-docs-2), and cubic learning from replies to calibrate behavior (cubic-docs-10), showing in-context, in-thread interaction. Community feedback also praises the depth of technical explanations it gives compared to plain LLM chat (cubic-comm-1). missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of multi-turn contextual Q&A threads and no detail on how well it handles complex/ambiguous follow-up commands.
